case_title: Balvir Singh v. State of Madhya Pradesh
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.34; Arms Act s.25(1A) r/w s.27
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.302, s.34 IPC and s.25(1A)/s.27 Arms Act
neutral_facts: The accused, along with others, were involved in an incident where the victim was stopped by the accused on a motor cycle. The accused then attacked the victim, with one of them firing a shot from a close range, resulting in the victim's instant death. The incident was witnessed by multiple individuals, and the victim sustained severe injuries, including gunshot wounds to the face and other injuries to the back and arms. The prosecution relied on eyewitness accounts, medical reports, and forensic evidence to establish the sequence of events. The accused were initially convicted, but the conviction of some was overturned on appeal due to insufficient evidence of common intention.
